subject.title: Discord plugin does not auto-reconnect after 1006 WS close (forces full gateway restart, kills in-flight turns)

question: Should maintainers require a live Discord or focused transport-harness reproduction of the natural 1005/1006 stale-reconnect path before allowing a ClawSweeper fix PR?
rationale: Current source already contains a nominal reconnect path, while release evidence shows that path still fails in practice; the proof bar determines whether automation can safely edit this mature channel transport.

options.title: Require live or harness proof first
options.body: Keep this issue in maintainer review until a reproducible live Discord or focused transport harness trace shows where reconnect stalls after 1005/1006.

options.title: Queue an exploratory fix PR
options.body: Allow an automated repair to add a focused regression harness and patch the likely lifecycle gap, accepting that the first PR may need maintainer iteration.

options.title: Prioritize manual reconnect fallback
options.body: First expose a turn-safe Discord provider reconnect action for operators, then treat automatic recovery as follow-up work.

recommendation.title: Require live or harness proof first
recommendation.body: Keep this issue in maintainer review until a reproducible live Discord or focused transport harness trace shows where reconnect stalls after 1005/1006.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the clearest recent reviewer/landing context for the adjacent Discord gateway lifecycle fix and can decide the proof bar.
